explanation: Implemented all ten B06 edits against the accepted canvases, adding chat lifecycle and push-generation detail with the two planned edges. Updated asynchronous per-call exec/replay, current reads, shared panels, selection references, and durable checkpoint publication. Push comparisons use pinned commits; explicit baseline-session reuse remains separate because automatic previous-generation linkage is absent from the supplied source. Existing attachment labels and reserved bounds are preserved. Later direct submission and managed generation remain unimplemented.
